stance_rationale: Numerical PSD/condition checks pass, but the risk package materially misclassifies tail/stress risk, omits required optimizer-weight schedule evidence, and substitutes an EW top20 snapshot plus retrospective 2022+ regime split for the requested walk-forward risk audit. RF-R4, tail-risk, regime, crowding-vs-PG2, and Charter §8 evidence gaps are too large for conditional approval.

regime_sigma_audit.comment: RF-R8 sample-size trigger is not hit under the package's 2022+ proxy, but the formal BULL/NORMAL/CAUTION/CRISIS regime-sigma audit, PIT t-1 regime labels, bootstrap CI, and switch-rate budget are absent.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: UNVERIFIED: package reports single-book TDC/sector/vol proxies, not TDC or crowding HHI versus the existing PG2 active book; style correlation versus active book is also missing.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: weights.csv is absent and covariance is a single as_of 2023-10-31 top20 matrix, so the requested walk-forward schedule cannot be verified.
regime audit uses retrospective crisis_2022plus split, not documented t-1 lagged expanding percentile regime labels.
no FRED/external macro series are used in the risk package.
security returns used for covariance are RAWDATA Date<=2023-10-31; however FF5/RMW/CMA style-return coverage remains partial.

critical_concerns.description: RF-R4 is misclassified: prompt RF-R4 is stress loss >25%, but the package redefines it as market_down_5<-8%. Actual stress losses include COVID 2020 -40.1% and GFC 2008 -28.5%, so red_flags=[] is not defensible.

Tail-risk gate is breached or unit-inconsistent: package reports daily CVaR95 3.43%, already above the 2.5% monthly cap, while an EW monthly reconstruction gives CVaR95 about 16.25%; CDaR, EVT-GPD, and parametric+EVT VaR/ES are absent.

The stated Sigma=BΩB'+D structure is not the emitted security covariance: reconstructing BΩB'+D from exposure_matrix/factor_covariance/specific_risk differs from covariance.parquet by max_abs_diff 0.0814, and mean market R2 is only 22.96% with 15/20 names below 30%.

Regime-conditional Sigma is not PIT-auditable: crisis_2022plus is a retrospective window proxy, BULL/CAUTION labels are missing, switch-rate estimated versus realized is absent, and no bootstrap/fallback policy is provided for formal thin regimes.

Crowding and redundancy checks do not verify the required active-book metrics: TDC vs PG2 active, crowding HHI vs existing book, and style correlation vs existing active are missing; self-snapshot TDC 0.279 and sector HHI 0.115 cannot clear RF-R3/RF-R5.

weights.csv and risk_challenge_note.md are absent, and artifact_lineage.json has no risk package entry; therefore Charter §8 No Silent Override and the requested time-series schedule verification are not satisfied.

RF checklist thresholds in the package do not match the role prompt: RF-R2 is assessed against 500 instead of 100, RF-R4 is redefined, RF-R7 is not addressed, and method candidates omit DCC-Copula despite the risk checklist.

supporting_arguments: Positive: covariance.parquet exists in the actual FLOW stage dir, is 20x20 symmetric, min eigenvalue 0.104625, condition number 6.500452, so RF-R2 and RF-R9 are not triggered numerically.
Positive: alpha_scores.parquet is time-series, not single snapshot: 67,330 rows, 226 dates from 2005-01-31 to 2023-10-31, 751 tickers, and only Date/Ticker/alpha_score/confidence columns.

RF status: RF-R1 PASS; RF-R2 PASS; RF-R3 UNVERIFIED; RF-R4 FAIL; RF-R5 UNVERIFIED; RF-R6 externally not triggered but package omitted EVT; RF-R7 UNVERIFIED; RF-R8 not triggered by proxy n but formal regime audit fails; RF-R9 PASS.
unresolved_disputes: Which artifact namespace is canonical: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260529_001 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260529_001 are absent, while the package uses stage_artifacts/WT_D20260529_001_FLOW.
Whether the risk package is intended to audit only an EW top20 as_of snapshot or the final optimizer-weighted walk-forward sleeve; the requested weights.csv is absent.
Whether TDC vs PG2 active book is cross-sectional holdings overlap, time-series co-crash dependence, or style-factor correlation; the package does not define or compute it.
Whether FLOW's standalone alpha failure should cap risk approval to research-only sleeve analysis before optimizer handoff.
weakest_assumption: The single most fragile claim is that an equal-weight 2023-10-31 top20 snapshot with a retrospective 2022+ stress proxy represents the true optimizer-weighted, walk-forward, regime-conditional risk of the FLOW sleeve.
rebuttal_required: Provide weights.csv with multi-date schedule, sum-to-one checks, bounds, turnover, and link it to risk calculations.
Emit risk_challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage entry for risk_package_draft.json.
Rebuild RF-R1 through RF-R9 using the role-prompt definitions, especially RF-R4 stress >25% and RF-R2 cond >100.
Either emit a covariance that exactly equals BΩB'+D or relabel covariance.parquet as selected LW security covariance with BΩB'+D only as an explanatory exposure diagnostic.
Provide formal PIT regime labels, switch rates, bootstrap CI/fallback policy, CDaR, monthly CVaR, EVT-GPD/Hill, parametric+EVT VaR/ES, and all 8 stress periods.
rationalization_red_flags: Intrinsic crowding of the resulting holdings is structurally LOW
not capturable from this single-book snapshot
COVID 2020 status OK despite -40.1% sleeve stress loss

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Numerical covariance stability is real, but it is not sufficient. The external risk critique rejects the package because required RF, tail, crowding, regime, schedule, and governance evidence are missing or mis-scored.

risk_specific_questions: If covariance.parquet is selected Ledoit-Wolf Sigma, why is the package presenting it as Sigma=BΩB'+D when the emitted B/Omega/D artifacts do not reconstruct it?
How can RF-R4 be PASS when COVID 2020 sleeve stress is -40.1% and the prompt threshold is a single stress period loss greater than 25%?
What exact object is TDC vs PG2 active book: holdings cross-section, return time-series tail dependence, or style-factor exposure correlation?
